definitions.gloss: to arrange to meet, to rendezvous, to meet up at a set time and place
definitions.explanation: To agree on a time and place in advance and then meet there. The noun form 待ち合わせ is very common for referring to the meeting arrangement itself.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}の{前|まえ}で{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせる。
examples.english: To meet up in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}と{三時|さんじ}に{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせている。
examples.english: I'm meeting a friend at three o'clock.

examples.japanese: {待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせの{場所|ばしょ}を{間違|まちが}えてしまった。
examples.english: I mistakenly went to the wrong meeting place.

notes:
{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせる is a compound of {待|ま}つ (to wait) and {合|あ}わせる (to bring together). The noun form {待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせ is used more frequently than the verb form.

Ichidan verb.
- Negative: {待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせない
- Polite: {待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせます
- Te-form: {待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせて
- Past: {待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせた
- Noun form: {待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせ (meeting arrangement)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせの{場所|ばしょ}: meeting place
- {待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせの{時間|じかん}: meeting time
- {待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせに{遅|おく}れる: to be late for a meetup
